[RLOW.9.3.1] A synthetic name is legal as a schema or rule name in the DSC
metadata atoms, which carry names as strings. The compiler emits synthetic
names unchanged into the schema-name, rule-name and fact-name positions of the
atom set. It writes no `.proto` text for a synthetic schema ([RDSC.5.8.3]): no
protobuf identifier can hold a `$`.
